intro.title: Explore Parque Natural Cerro Verde
intro.description: Parque Natural Cerro Verde is located in Santa Ana Department, El Salvador. It is a beautiful national park with spectacular mountain views and rich ecological environment, making it an important natural protection and tourism attraction in El Salvador.

visitGuide.title: Visiting Tips
items: Bring a camera to capture spectacular natural scenery
Carry enough water and sun protection

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: Spectacular mountain views: Overlook the entire Santa Ana area and surrounding beautiful scenery.
Rich ecology: Home to diverse flora and fauna, a paradise for nature lovers.
Cool climate: High altitude with cool and pleasant climate.
Prime location: Located in Santa Ana Department with convenient access.

route.title: Tour Route
route.overview: Discover the ideal route to explore Parque Natural Cerro Verde and experience the essence of natural scenery and El Salvador's ecological conservation.
steps: Start from the entrance and climb up along the main trail.
Stop at the viewpoint to enjoy spectacular mountain views and panoramic scenery.
Continue exploring the surrounding nature trails and feel the fresh mountain air.
Rest at the park's rest area and enjoy the tranquility of nature.
supplements: It's recommended to go in the morning to avoid crowds and enjoy fresh air.
Pay attention to sun protection as UV rays are stronger at high altitudes.
Please take your trash with you to protect the natural environment.

sections.title: Historical Significance
sections.content: Parque Natural Cerro Verde is an important natural protection and ecotourism landmark in El Salvador, and has long been a favorite leisure place for local residents and tourists.

sections.title: Natural Landscape
sections.content: It features spectacular mountain views and rich vegetation, making it an excellent place to experience the natural beauty of El Salvador.

sections.title: Visiting Experience
sections.content: Strolling through Parque Natural Cerro Verde, feeling the cool mountain climate and magnificent natural scenery, is an unforgettable nature experience.

hours.title: Opening Hours
hours.summerTime: Pleasant weather, ideal for outdoor visits
hours.winterTime: Warm weather with afternoon rains, bring umbrella
hours.warningTime: Recommended to verify latest information before visiting
hours.tip: Daytime visits offer the best experience

transport.title: Transportation
transport.airportDesc: Nearest airport: El Salvador International Airport (SAL). From there, take a bus or taxi to Santa Ana Department.
transport.selfDriveDesc: The park is located in Santa Ana Department. Use navigation and check for parking nearby.
transport.busDesc: You can take public transport to Santa Ana Department, then walk or take a taxi to the park.
transport.intercityDesc: There are walking trails in the park, walkable to various attractions.
transport.cyclingDesc: Public transport or driving recommended, convenient transportation around the park.
transport.tipsDesc: Parque Natural Cerro Verde is an excellent place to experience El Salvador's natural scenery, daytime visits recommended.

officialManagement.title: About Parque Natural Cerro Verde
officialManagement.text: Parque Natural Cerro Verde is a famous natural landscape in Santa Ana Department, featuring spectacular mountain views and rich natural and cultural value.

historyTimeline.title: Historical Timeline

items.title: Early Period: Natural Formation
items.description: Cerro Verde is a naturally formed spectacular mountain view that has long been a favorite place for local residents.

items.title: 20th Century: Tourism Development
items.description: With the development of tourism in El Salvador, Cerro Verde gradually became a popular tourist attraction with continuously improving facilities.

items.title: 21st Century: Ecotourism Destination
items.description: In the 21st century, Cerro Verde attracts more and more visitors with its spectacular natural scenery, becoming an important window to experience El Salvador's ecotourism.

historyTimeline.guideContent: When visiting, you can start from the **entrance** to feel the natural atmosphere; then enjoy the spectacular mountain views at the **viewpoint**; next, explore the **nature trails** to feel the fresh mountain air; finally, rest at the **rest area** to deeply understand the important position of these natural landscapes in El Salvador's natural culture.
